info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Summarys-v4-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Summary API provides an overview of the items currently in a user's shopping cart. It allows developers to programmatically access detailed summaries of cart contents, including product details, quantities, and pricing. This API is typically utilized by web and mobile applications to enhance user experience by presenting real-time cart information. It serves as a vital resource for businesses aiming to streamline the online shopping process and optimize customer engagement.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the summary of the current shopping cart, including total items, total price, and any applicable discounts. It is useful for understanding the state of the cart before proceeding to checkout.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the summary of a shopping cart. This request should include the necessary authentication details and any relevant parameters to ensure the cart summary is fetched accurately.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the shopping cart summary.

ListEcommerceCartSummarysRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for the GET operations related to the cart summary.

resultId.description: A unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the cart.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.
